items.headline: US rail freight volumes rise, metals lead gains
items.summary: AAR reported US rail traffic up 2.4% year-on-year for the week ending August 1, with metallic ores and metals up 9.1% and petroleum products up 5.9%, per FreightWaves.

items.headline: EU ETS reform discussed with ETRM industry expert
items.summary: CTRM Center published a discussion with an ETRMServices markets expert on the European Commission's proposed EU Emissions Trading System reforms and their implications for trading desks.

items.headline: ACER opens consultation on REMIT reporting annex
items.summary: Europe's energy regulator ACER launched a public consultation on a new annex to its REMIT transaction reporting guideline covering energy derivative contracts, following REMIT II's entry into force in April.

items.headline: Trade finance report flags fintech, blockchain growth
items.summary: A new commodity trade finance market forecast highlighted fintech-driven platforms and blockchain adoption reshaping letters of credit and structured trade finance, with Asia-Pacific tipped as the fastest-growing region.
